messages.text: Based on current vault evidence, what are the strongest opportunities for Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer in Automotive, and what evidence supports each opportunity?

### Recommended focus
Current vault evidence does not rank opportunities, but the best-supported automotive Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer opportunities are: NG eCall / hybrid eCall validation with CMX500, eCall GNSS testing with SMBV100B, automotive radar validation around AREG800A with analyzer support, and automated RF conformance-style systems using signal analyzers/generators where automotive connectivity programs need repeatable testing [40][39][64][16].
### Recommended to sell first
1. **CMX500 for NG eCall / hybrid eCall automotive validation** — Evidence is strongest because the vault ties automotive regulatory transition, Qualcomm/Snapdragon automotive validation, EN 17240:2024, 4G/5G IMS eCall, and CMX500 + CMX-KA098 directly together [40][73][7].  
2. **SMBV100B for eCall GNSS testing** — Evidence is strong because the configuration guide explicitly lists eCall GNSS Testing with SMBV100B as the base unit and GNSS/eCall test-suite items [39][37].  
3. **AREG800A-centered automotive radar validation, with Signal Analyzer as supporting measurement role** — Evidence is strong for automotive radar echo generation itself, and the vault explicitly states Doppler frequency offset accuracy is measured in the IF domain using a spectrum analyzer, but AREG800A is not itself an RF signal generator or spectrum analyzer [64][61][62][5].  
4. **FSW / external analyzer role for radar and wideband RF analysis** — Evidence supports FSW’s high-end signal/spectrum analyzer capability up to 85 GHz or 90 GHz with option and wide analysis bandwidths, but the vault does not directly state FSW is used for automotive radar testing [21][90][88].  
### Product and option mapping

| R&S CMX500 | NG eCall over 4G/5G, EN 17240:2024, IMS voice/data, realistic network-condition testing | CMX500 with CMX-KA098 is stated as usable for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions, and the verification used CMX500 as the mobile radio tester [40] | Automotive demand is supported by the transition from obsolete 2G/3G circuit-switched networks to 4G/5G packet-switched eCall and the stated 2026-01-01 NG eCall obligation [73] | R&S and Qualcomm verified Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF NG eCall functionality using CMX500 and validated both ends against EN 17240:2024 [7][40] | The press-release source does not provide CMX500 configuration, CMX-KA098 version, license dependencies, full test setup, IMS configuration, GNSS setup, or pass/fail details [42] |
| R&S CMX500 | 5G/LTE automotive connectivity RF parametric testing where generator/analyzer functions are needed | CMX500 includes vector signal analysis and ARB generator for FR2 transmitter/receiver RF parametric testing, and 5G NR receiver tests can use internal baseband fading emulation [25] | This supports a combined signal-generation and signal-analysis sales motion inside one radio communication tester rather than a standalone generator/analyzer sale [25][76] | CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement solution supporting LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD [25][78] | The vault links CMX500 strongly to NG eCall and device testing, but does not provide automotive customer adoption details beyond the Qualcomm/Snapdragon verification event [42] |

| eCall GNSS testing | SMBV100B-based eCall GNSS Testing configuration [39] | Lead with GNSS simulation and eCall test-suite configuration rather than generic RF signal generation [37][39] | Configuration guide entries are not formal technical specifications, and formal SMBV100B specs must be checked for any frequency-range or option-detail conflict [31][38] |
| Automotive radar sensor validation | AREG800A radar echo generator, with analyzer support for IF-domain spectrum measurements where needed [64][62] | Lead with dynamic artificial object generation, FMCW support, 76 GHz to 81 GHz radar-band coverage, generated distances up to 3000 m, Doppler shift, and velocity settings [61][70][62] | AREG800A is not an RF signal generator or spectrum analyzer, and the vault does not name a specific analyzer model for the spectrum-analyzer measurement [5][62] |
| Wideband radar-band analysis prospecting | FSW family as high-end signal/spectrum analyzer candidate, subject to confirmation [21][90] | Lead with frequency coverage up to 85 GHz or 90 GHz and wide analysis bandwidth options when the customer needs signal/spectrum analysis at radar-band frequencies [21][88][90] | The vault does not directly connect FSW to automotive radar testing, so this must be presented as a capability fit to be validated, not a confirmed automotive application reference [21][70] |
| Automated RF conformance / production-style testing | CONTEST-based system using CMX500 or CMW500 plus FSW vector signal analyzer, SMW200A vector signal generator, switching, power, chambers, and automation [16][18] | Lead with automation, DUT transmitter measurements, baseband fading, multipath, Doppler, interference, and remote-controlled environmental equipment [16][17] | The cited system manual scope is TS8980FTA/PRE and cannot be generalized to all R&S CONTEST-based automotive test systems without project-specific confirmation [84] |

【推論】The highest-confidence first sales motion is CMX500 for NG eCall because the vault combines regulatory transition pressure, automotive modem validation, EN 17240:2024, and CMX500 + CMX-KA098 in one evidence chain [73][7][40].  
【推論】The clearest standalone Signal Generator automotive opportunity is SMBV100B for eCall GNSS testing because the vault explicitly identifies SMBV100B as the base unit in an eCall GNSS Testing configuration and separately identifies SMBV100B as a vector signal generator [39][60].  
【推論】The clearest Signal Analyzer expansion around automotive radar is analyzer support for AREG800A IF-domain Doppler verification, because the AREG800A evidence explicitly mentions spectrum-analyzer measurement while FSW provides the documented high-end signal/spectrum analyzer portfolio capability [62][21].  
### Limitations
The vault does not provide a ranked market-sizing view, customer pipeline, revenue, price, win rate, competitor comparison, or formal “strongest opportunity” ranking for Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer in Automotive [42][29][31].

Hybrid eCall testing
[[Hybrid eCall testing]] 是驗證車輛 emergency call system 能在 NG eCall 與 classic CS eCall transport paths 之間可靠運作與 fallback 的測試主題；[[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]] 將其連到 [[EN 18052]]:2025、[[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026、[[R&S CMX500]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KA09x]]。

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試目的
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]，hybrid eCall test specification [[EN 18052]] 要求 hybrid system combine different transmission paths and protocols，確保 eCall reliably reaches its destination。

來源描述的實務語境：

- 車輛使用 NG eCall functions，即 IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G。
- 當 coverage 或 service quality degrades 時，車輛可 automatically fall back to available classic CS eCall 2G/3G transport paths。
- Manufacturers 需要 validate hybrid implementations，以確保能 trigger calls、transmit [[MSD]]、maintain [[GNSS]] positioning，並提供 intelligible voice quality。

Hybrid eCall testing › 與 NGeCall over LTE / NR-LTE 的關係
[[NGeCall over LTE]] 與 [[NGeCall over NR-LTE]] 關注 NG eCall 在 IMS / packet-switched 4G/5G 路徑上的測試支援與標準對照。[[Hybrid eCall testing]] 進一步把 NG eCall 與 classic CS eCall fallback、handover、degraded radio conditions 與 multi-path robustness 放在同一驗證範圍內。

NGeCall over LTE › 支援限制
- 來源明示 [[R&S CMW500]] 或 [[R&S CMX500]] 有時只支援部分測試，或某些測試需要 further equipment。
- 多個測試不是單靠 [[R&S CMW-KA096]]、[[R&S CMWrun KT111]]、[[R&S CMX-KA098]] 或 [[R&S CMX-KF671B]] 即可完整自動化，因為需要 HMI interaction、engine / ignition OFF 控制、AT command、IVS debugging tool、Prepared TestUSIM、handset、crash simulation、in-band modem over IP support 或 IVS SUT IP address check。
- CMW500 / CMW-KA096 來源中，CTP 1.1.10.1-IMS limited service condition 標示 Partly Available，需 Prepared TestUSIM with Forbidden PLMN 001 02，且 attach reject by network not supported yet。
- CMX500 / CMX-KA098 來源中，CEN EN 17240:2024 limited service tests 說明有兩種方式：使用 Prepared TestUSIM with Forbidden PLMN 001 02，或 rejecting normal attach reject but accepting emergency attach；後者 currently not supported。
- CMW500 / CMW-KA096 來源中，CTP 1.1.17.2-IMS callback abnormal termination 標示 Not available。
- 3GPP TS 34.229-1 21.3 在既有 CMW500 來源中標示 Not available；CMX500 來源中 34.229-1 區段也可辨識 Not Available 標註。
- 兩份來源都保留 legacy CS domain eCall with inband-modem 到 NGeCall over IMS 的 transition 尚未由 EU commission 最終決定，因此部分 handover test cases 尚未實作的限制。

NGeCall over LTE › 來源中的測試主題
兩份 capability lists 中反覆出現的測試主題包含：

- IVS manual eCall、automatic eCall、test eCall initiation。
- IMS eCall session establishment，包含 `urn:service:sos:ecall:automatic`、`urn:service:sos:ecall:manual`、`urn:service:test.sos.ecall` 等語彙。
- MSD transfer、MSD update、PSAP request、negative acknowledgement / missing acknowledgement 情境。
- Valid SIM/USIM、forbidden PLMN、limited service condition、roaming scenario。
- PSAP initiated callback、call clear-down、IVS initiated clear-down not allowed。
- Voice link established 與 audio interface verification。
- eCall only mode、T3444 / T3445、SRVCC handover to CS domain / UTRAN / GERAN。
- Time-Warping Conformance Test / No Time-Warping Conformance Test。
- CMX500 來源新增 5GS / NR 相關 3GPP TS 34.229-5 與 3GPP TS 38.523-1 測試脈絡。
- CMX500 來源新增 CEN EN 17240:2024 中 IPv4 / IPv6 MSD transfer、MSD version 3、additional data from Euro NCAP TB 040:2022 等項目。

R&S CMX-KA098 › 功能與測試範圍摘錄

- IMS eCall session establishment，包含 automatic、manual 與 test eCall。
- SIM/USIM conformance、network registration、limited service condition、eCall-only IVS cases。
- MSD transfer、MSD update、negative AL-ACK、missing AL-ACK、IPv4 / IPv6 MSD transfer。
- Voice link established、audio interface verification、Time-Warping / No Time-Warping conformance test。
- PSAP callback、clear-down、remain registered、redial / no-redial cases。
- 5GS / NR 相關 eCall over IMS cases，由 [[3GPP TS 34.229-5]] 與 [[3GPP TS 38.523-1]] 區段支撐。
- LTE / EPS 相關 eCall over IMS cases，由 [[3GPP TS 34.229-1]] 與 [[3GPP TS 36.523-1]] 區段支撐。

### Recommended focus
Current vault evidence does not rank opportunities, but the best-supported automotive Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer opportunities are: NG eCall / hybrid eCall validation with CMX500, eCall GNSS testing with SMBV100B, automotive radar validation around AREG800A with analyzer support, and automated RF conformance-style systems using signal analyzers/generators where automotive connectivity programs need repeatable testing [40][39][64][16].
### Recommended to sell first
1. **CMX500 for NG eCall / hybrid eCall automotive validation** — Evidence is strongest because the vault ties automotive regulatory transition, Qualcomm/Snapdragon automotive validation, EN 17240:2024, 4G/5G IMS eCall, and CMX500 + CMX-KA098 directly together [40][73][7].  
2. **SMBV100B for eCall GNSS testing** — Evidence is strong because the configuration guide explicitly lists eCall GNSS Testing with SMBV100B as the base unit and GNSS/eCall test-suite items [39][37].  
3. **AREG800A-centered automotive radar validation, with Signal Analyzer as supporting measurement role** — Evidence is strong for automotive radar echo generation itself, and the vault explicitly states Doppler frequency offset accuracy is measured in the IF domain using a spectrum analyzer, but AREG800A is not itself an RF signal generator or spectrum analyzer [64][61][62][5].  
4. **FSW / external analyzer role for radar and wideband RF analysis** — Evidence supports FSW’s high-end signal/spectrum analyzer capability up to 85 GHz or 90 GHz with option and wide analysis bandwidths, but the vault does not directly state FSW is used for automotive radar testing [21][90][88].  
### Product and option mapping
| Product line | Automotive need it can connect to | Vault-confirmed option / specification | Why it fits | Evidence | Gap / quoting risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 | NG eCall over 4G/5G, EN 17240:2024, IMS voice/data, realistic network-condition testing | CMX500 with CMX-KA098 is stated as usable for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions, and the verification used CMX500 as the mobile radio tester [40] | Automotive demand is supported by the transition from obsolete 2G/3G circuit-switched networks to 4G/5G packet-switched eCall and the stated 2026-01-01 NG eCall obligation [73] | R&S and Qualcomm verified Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF NG eCall functionality using CMX500 and validated both ends against EN 17240:2024 [7][40] | The press-release source does not provide CMX500 configuration, CMX-KA098 version, license dependencies, full test setup, IMS configuration, GNSS setup, or pass/fail details [42] |
| R&S CMX500 | 5G/LTE automotive connectivity RF parametric testing where generator/analyzer functions are needed | CMX500 includes vector signal analysis and ARB generator for FR2 transmitter/receiver RF parametric testing, and 5G NR receiver tests can use internal baseband fading emulation [25] | This supports a combined signal-generation and signal-analysis sales motion inside one radio communication tester rather than a standalone generator/analyzer sale [25][76] | CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement solution supporting LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD [25][78] | The vault links CMX500 strongly to NG eCall and device testing, but does not provide automotive customer adoption details beyond the Qualcomm/Snapdragon verification event [42] |
| R&S SMBV100B | eCall GNSS testing | The configuration guide lists eCall GNSS Testing with SMBV100B as the base unit and includes SMBVB-B103, SMBVB-K520, SMBVB-K44, SMBV-K66, SMBV-K94, SMBVB-K137, SMBVB-K106, SMBVB-K108, and SMBV-K361 as GNSS / eCall test-suite items [39] | This is a clean Signal Generator opportunity because SMBV100B is a vector signal generator and the eCall GNSS configuration is explicitly automotive eCall-related [60][39] | The CMX configuration guide identifies SMBV100B as the vector signal generator for eCall GNSS Testing [37] | The configuration guide is not a technical specifications data sheet, and one SMBVB-B103 description conflicts with the existing SMBV100B specifications page, so formal specs must be checked before quoting [31][38] |

### Inference lines
【推論】The highest-confidence first sales motion is CMX500 for NG eCall because the vault combines regulatory transition pressure, automotive modem validation, EN 17240:2024, and CMX500 + CMX-KA098 in one evidence chain [73][7][40].  
【推論】The clearest standalone Signal Generator automotive opportunity is SMBV100B for eCall GNSS testing because the vault explicitly identifies SMBV100B as the base unit in an eCall GNSS Testing configuration and separately identifies SMBV100B as a vector signal generator [39][60].  
【推論】The clearest Signal Analyzer expansion around automotive radar is analyzer support for AREG800A IF-domain Doppler verification, because the AREG800A evidence explicitly mentions spectrum-analyzer measurement while FSW provides the documented high-end signal/spectrum analyzer portfolio capability [62][21].  
### Limitations
The vault does not provide a ranked market-sizing view, customer pipeline, revenue, price, win rate, competitor comparison, or formal “strongest opportunity” ranking for Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer in Automotive [42][29][31].  
Press-release evidence for NG eCall is verification evidence, not a complete certification report or conformance test plan, and it lacks test case IDs, detailed conditions, software versions, and pass/fail details [9][42].  
Configuration-guide evidence can support configuration context, but it is not a formal technical specifications data sheet and should not replace product specifications for quoting or compliance claims [31].

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 驗證範圍
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard]]：

R&S CONTEST-based test systems › 架構層級
依 [[RS_TS8980FTA_PRE_Series_SystemManual_en_63]]：

- [[R&S CONTEST]] 執行於所有 system configurations。
- 在列出的 test system types 中，[[R&S CONTEST]] 執行於 system controller PC。
- System controller PC 執行 [[R&S CONTEST]] GUI、test applications、tools，並支援 devices 的 remote control。
- 系統主要測試儀器為 [[R&S CMW500]] 或 [[R&S CMX500]]。
- [[R&S CMW500]] 或 [[R&S CMX500]] 對 DUT 模擬 NR、LTE、WCDMA、TD-SCDMA、GSM 或 CDMA2000 network，建立 link 並執行 dedicated measurements。
- 系統可包含 spectrum analyzer 或 vector signal analyzer，用於 DUT transmitter measurements。
- 額外 signal generators、[[R&S CMW500]] 與 [[R&S CMX500]] 可包含 baseband fading，用於模擬 multi-path、Doppler 與 interference conditions。
- 所有 devices 透過 cable set 與 connection box 或 switching box 耦合。
- Auxiliary devices 包含 power meter 或 power supply。
- Climate chambers 或 vibration tables 等外部設備可 remote control，並納入 automated testing process。

R&S CONTEST-based test systems › Operation and calibration
依 [[RS_TS8980FTA_PRE_Series_SystemManual_en_63]]：

- 所有 instruments power-on 後，需要至少 2 小時 warm-up time，才能達到符合 measurement uncertainty analysis 的 measurement results。
- Warm-up time 內不得呼叫 system PTC 與 device internal calibration capabilities，以避免 falsification of system calibration data。
- [[R&S CS-RUB]] warm-up time 遠超過 2 小時，因此建議永久連接 mains。
- Regular calibration 可確保 Rohde & Schwarz test system 的 optimum performance、correct measurements 與 availability。
- RF paths 已 calibration 時，system 需維持在 ±2 °C temperature range；否則需 recalibrate RF paths。
- Rated temperature range：23 °C ± 3 °C；relative humidity：20% 至 80%，non-condensing。

R&S FSW
R&S FSW 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 high-end Signal and Spectrum Analyzer 系列，依 Version 17.01（September 2025）涵蓋 8 GHz 至 85 GHz 型號，[[R&S FSW85]] 搭配 R&S FSW-B90G 可延伸至 90 GHz。

Hybrid eCall testing
[[Hybrid eCall testing]] 是驗證車輛 emergency call system 能在 NG eCall 與 classic CS eCall transport paths 之間可靠運作與 fallback 的測試主題；[[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]] 將其連到 [[EN 18052]]:2025、[[EN 17240]]:2024+A1:2026、[[R&S CMX500]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KA09x]]。

Hybrid eCall testing › 測試目的
依 [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]]，hybrid eCall test specification [[EN 18052]] 要求 hybrid system combine different transmission paths and protocols，確保 eCall reliably reaches its destination。

來源描述的實務語境：

- 車輛使用 NG eCall functions，即 IP/IMS-based voice and data over 4G/5G。
- 當 coverage 或 service quality degrades 時，車輛可 automatically fall back to available classic CS eCall 2G/3G transport paths。
- Manufacturers 需要 validate hybrid implementations，以確保能 trigger calls、transmit [[MSD]]、maintain [[GNSS]] positioning，並提供 intelligible voice quality。

Hybrid eCall testing › 與 NGeCall over LTE / NR-LTE 的關係
[[NGeCall over LTE]] 與 [[NGeCall over NR-LTE]] 關注 NG eCall 在 IMS / packet-switched 4G/5G 路徑上的測試支援與標準對照。[[Hybrid eCall testing]] 進一步把 NG eCall 與 classic CS eCall fallback、handover、degraded radio conditions 與 multi-path robustness 放在同一驗證範圍內。

NGeCall over LTE › 支援限制
- 來源明示 [[R&S CMW500]] 或 [[R&S CMX500]] 有時只支援部分測試，或某些測試需要 further equipment。
- 多個測試不是單靠 [[R&S CMW-KA096]]、[[R&S CMWrun KT111]]、[[R&S CMX-KA098]] 或 [[R&S CMX-KF671B]] 即可完整自動化，因為需要 HMI interaction、engine / ignition OFF 控制、AT command、IVS debugging tool、Prepared TestUSIM、handset、crash simulation、in-band modem over IP support 或 IVS SUT IP address check。
- CMW500 / CMW-KA096 來源中，CTP 1.1.10.1-IMS limited service condition 標示 Partly Available，需 Prepared TestUSIM with Forbidden PLMN 001 02，且 attach reject by network not supported yet。
- CMX500 / CMX-KA098 來源中，CEN EN 17240:2024 limited service tests 說明有兩種方式：使用 Prepared TestUSIM with Forbidden PLMN 001 02，或 rejecting normal attach reject but accepting emergency attach；後者 currently not supported。
- CMW500 / CMW-KA096 來源中，CTP 1.1.17.2-IMS callback abnormal termination 標示 Not available。
- 3GPP TS 34.229-1 21.3 在既有 CMW500 來源中標示 Not available；CMX500 來源中 34.229-1 區段也可辨識 Not Available 標註。
- 兩份來源都保留 legacy CS domain eCall with inband-modem 到 NGeCall over IMS 的 transition 尚未由 EU commission 最終決定，因此部分 handover test cases 尚未實作的限制。

R&S CMX-KA098 › 使用限制
- 本頁只記錄來源明示的 license swap mapping、capability listing 與 software maintenance PU mapping。
- 不可由 CMX-KA098 名稱或 Ident No 推論報價、可購買性、license dependency、所有客戶適用條款或 service entitlement。
- [[CMX-KA098_CMX-KF671B_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]] 是 lossy derivative；表格欄位有缺失與 OCR 錯位，完整 test status 需回原始 PDF / Excel 確認。
- [[CMX500_Software_Maintenance_PU-Option_Mapping]] 是 Excel 轉出的 lossy derivative；原始 `.xlsx` 才是 source of truth。
- 多個測試需要 external equipment、Prepared TestUSIM、handset、IVS debugging tool、HMI interaction、engine / ignition control、in-band modem over IP support 或 IVS SUT IP address check。
- 涉及 legacy CS domain eCall with inband-modem 到 NGeCall over IMS transition 的 handover cases，來源說 EU commission 尚未最終決定，因此部分 test cases 尚未實作。

R&S SMBV100B › 文件與適用範圍
- 主要來源：[[SMBV100B_specs_en_3607-8201-22_v1301]]。
- 文件：R&S®SMBV100B Vector Signal Generator Specifications。
- 文件編號：PD 3607.8201.22。
- 文件版次：Specifications Version 13.01。
- 文件日期：August 2025（footer：August 2025 (la)）。
- 產品：R&S®SMBV100B vector signal generator。
- 規格適用條件：ambient temperature 下 storage 3 hours、warm-up operation 30 minutes、specified environmental conditions met、recommended calibration interval adhered to、all applicable internal automatic adjustments performed。
- Rohde & Schwarz 不 warranted：Non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values。

R&S AREG800A › Echo generation
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- Echo generator type：`dynamic artificial object generation`。
- Echo generation concept：
  - `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。
  - `digital`：用於 [[FMCW radar]]；minimum generated distance 等於 radar under test 的 air gap value；maximum generated distance 為 `3000 m`。

R&S AREG800A › Radial velocity 與 Doppler
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- 每個 artificial object 支援 individual Doppler frequency shift：`yes`。
- Velocity setting range with [[R&S AREG8-B9]] and [[R&S AREG8-B63]]：`±500 km/h`。
- Velocity step size：
  - [[R&S AREG8-B9]] and [[R&S AREG8-B63]]：`0.001 km/h`。
  - [[R&S AREG-DBP1]] / [[R&S AREG-DBP2]] / [[R&S AREG-DBP3]] with [[R&S AREG-MFP]] / [[R&S AREG-BFP]]：`0.05 km/h`。
- Doppler frequency offset accuracy：在 IF domain 以 spectrum analyzer 量測 base unit IF input 與 IF output signal 的 frequency offset，不含 frontend，`< 1 Hz`。
- Velocity accuracy：Doppler shift velocity error 由公式 `v_error = 3.6 × (f_error/f_center) × ½ × 299 700 000 m/s` 決定；`f_center` 為 `78 GHz` 或 `79 GHz`，適用於 [[R&S AREG8-81S]] / [[R&S AREG8-81WS]] 與 [[R&S AREG8-81D]] / [[R&S AREG8-81WD]]；velocity accuracy `< 0.05 km/h`。

R&S AREG800A
[[R&S AREG800A]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Automotive Radar Echo Generator，用於 dynamic artificial object generation；本頁規格依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]]，文件版本 `Version 09.00`，文件日期 `September 2025（LA）`。

AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900 › 重點摘要
- Base unit instantaneous IF bandwidth 依 option 為 `1 GHz`、`2 GHz` 或 `5 GHz`；overrange 分別為 `1.2 GHz (meas.)`、`2.2 GHz (meas.)`、`5.2 GHz (meas.)`。
- AREG800A base unit IF frequency range：[[R&S AREG8-B9]] 為 `1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz`；[[R&S AREG8-B9]] with [[R&S AREG8-K527]] 為 `0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz`；來源另列 [[R&S AREG8-B9]] with [[R&S AREG8-K527]] 為 `0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz`，但 5 GHz bandwidth ordering information 顯示還涉及 [[R&S AREG8-K528]]，此處未自行推論修正。
- RF frequency bands：[[R&S AREG8-24S]] / [[R&S AREG8-24D]] 為 `24 GHz to 24.25 GHz`；[[R&S AREG8-81S]] / [[R&S AREG8-81D]] 與 [[R&S AREG8-81WS]] / [[R&S AREG8-81WD]]、[[R&S QAT100]] 為 `76 GHz to 81 GHz`；[[R&S FE44S]] 為 `24 GHz to 44 GHz`。
- 每台 [[R&S AREG800A]] base unit 支援 conventional mmWave frontends 最多 4 個，[[R&S QAT100]] 最多 8 個，[[R&S FE44S]] 最多 8 個 external frontends（4 個 TX、4 個 RX，共 4 pairs）。
- Artificial object distance 可依 option 涵蓋 `< 17 m to 3000 m (meas.)`、`< 4 m to 3000 m (meas.)`、`≥ air gap to 3000 m (meas.)`；production frontend 組合列為 FMCW `≥ air gap to 350 m (meas.)`，non FMCW `< 17 m to 350 m (meas.)`。
- Radial velocity：每個 artificial object 支援 individual Doppler frequency shift；with [[R&S AREG8-B9]] and [[R&S AREG8-B63]] velocity setting range 為 `±500 km/h`，velocity step size 為 `0.001 km/h`。
- Remote control interfaces 包含 Ethernet 與 [[R&S AREG8-K986]] GPIB；remote control command set 為 `SCPI`。
- HiL interface option 為 [[R&S AREG8-K109]]；open-standard protocol support 為 open simulation interface（OSI）；time synchronization protocol 為 `gPTP`、`NTP`。
- Base unit `AREG800A` Order No. `1437.4400.02`，包含 power cable 與 quick start guide。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › unresolved

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › Regulatory transition context
同一來源提供下列背景，但未列 regulation 文件編號：

- [[eCall]] automated vehicle emergency call system introduced in 2015。
- eCall 自 2018 年起是 all new cars sold within the European Union 的 mandatory requirement。
- 來源稱 2G / 3G circuit-switched cellular networks become obsolete，因此 emergency call systems 需要 adapted to 4G / 5G packet-switched cellular networks。
- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] most recent regulation 定義 NG eCall will be obligatory starting **2026-01-01**。
- 來源稱 EN 17240:2024 establishes guidelines for testing eCall systems over [[IMS]] networks, including advanced 4G LTE and 5G NR technologies。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

R&S CONTEST-based test systems › 使用限制
- 本概念頁依 [[RS_TS8980FTA_PRE_Series_SystemManual_en_63]] 建立；來源是 [[R&S TS8980FTA]] / [[R&S TS8980PRE]] system manual，不可直接外推到所有 Rohde & Schwarz CONTEST-based systems。
- 本頁不是 installation checklist；rack、power、PDU、fuse、cabling、safety 與 calibration 細節需回原 manual 與 individual instrument documentation。
- Test system component availability、supported test cases、validation status 與 software baseline 需依 release notes、R&S CONTEST hardware configuration、test package documentation 與 uncertainty documents 判定。
